name: Filter
description: Isang tool para sa mga photo effect: piliin ang halftone, scanline, posterize, voronoi, dither o ASCII art (vector) o duotone, pixel-stretch, imperfections o glitch (raster). Brand overlays, live camera, at mag-e-export sa kasing rami ng format na suportado ng bawat effect.
featured.blurb: Sampung photo effect, vector o raster, sa isang tool
